title: Therapy of metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer with Talazoparib + Enzalutamide under real world conditions in Germany – an observational medical chart review study
summary: This study, which involves secondary data collection and a supplementary manual review of medical patient records, is designed to systematically collect and analyze data on the efficacy and safety in patients with metastatic, castration-resistant prostate cancer who were treated with talazoparib in combination with enzalutamide under real-world conditions. This observational, retrospective secondary data study is being conducted in Germany at oncology and urology practices, as well as at hospitals with urology and oncology departments that specialize in the systemic treatment of prostate cancer.

interventions.name: Observation of patients with metastatic prostate cancer for up to 24 months who are receiving talazoparib and enzalutamide in approved indication as part of standard care. Treatment must have already begun at the time of study enrollment, and only secondary data from standard care will be used.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Age ≥18 years of age and assigned male sex at birth
- A diagnosis of mCRPC, as defined by histologically or cytologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the prostate (ICD-10th revision  C61) 
- Full medical information about treatments before and after start of talazoparib + enzalutamide as well as patient data for up to 24 months following initiation of talazoparib + enzalutamide should be available.
- Treatment with talazoparib + enzalutamide in approved indication was started before enrollment in study under discretion of physician and independent of study participation.
- Evidence of a personally signed and dated informed consent indicating that the patient (or a legally acceptable representative) has been informed of all pertinent aspects of the study
Exclusion criteria:
- Patients meeting any of the following criteria will not be included in the study:
- Treatment with talazoparib and enzalutamide in an investigational setting (off-label-use)
- Pre-treatment with a PARP inhibitor, e.g. in a clinical study
- Second active malignancy with exception of cancers that will not impact life expectancy of patients within the next 5 years
- Participation in an interventional clinical study within 30 days before start of talazoparib + enzalutamide.
